dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh, well, that's an easy one...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I love camping in all sorts of places — I'm not picky. Whenever I'm on the road delivering fruit, I'll park the cart and pitch a tent just about anywhere. It's comfortable enough for me!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I guess the only time I ever feel uncomfortable is during the team stage of the Pilgrimage. The looks from the other contestants are just too intense...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I guess, but this place is different!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I feel so... at ease. It's hard to find this feeling anywhere else.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: It's like... everything was arranged just for me — from the amenities, the landscaping, down to the tiniest details! I feel so at home! It's amazing!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I mean, sometimes, I have to be on guard even in my own place. Like when my mom rearranges the furniture, and I go to sit in my usual chair without thinking, just to land on the ground instead...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Thankfully, I've got some extra padding on me, so it didn't hurt, hehe.

choices.text: Well, you'd be right, because I did arrange this place just for you!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I can't believe a great hero did all this just for me! That's an honor even famous people never experience. It's like a real life power-up!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Okay, I'm pumped! Gotta train even harder now!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: C'mon, gimme a fist bump, hero!

choices.text: Guess we have a similar style, then!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: #I can't believe I have the same taste as {NICKNAME}. You've been to so many nations, and you're friends with so many heroes!
